versions.changelog: Every renderTable field is now escaped text, and raw-HTML input is gone; The SKILL; The claim is now true by construction: no caller markup or CSS can reach the output; Narrowed the description and added explicit exclusions; The padded table is now a bullet list, and the language line was reworded; JSDoc now types those fields as Content (escaped text or builder output); Refactored for readability only, nothing hidden; Reworded the prose that looked like paths: 'chip/bar/numb

First public release. Five-tier colour vocabulary, chip/bar/number primitives, a generic renderer and the per-domain column-spec pattern for building comparison tables a human reads at a glance. No network, no credentials.
